testScenarios.name: Verify Video Upload Date Approximation
testScenarios.description: Verify that the upload date approximation shown in search results matches the detailed upload date on the video page
testScenarios.expectedBehavior: Upload date approximation (e.g., '2 weeks ago') from search results should match the detailed date shown on video page

testScenarios.name: Verify Video View Count Consistency
testScenarios.description: Verify that the view count shown in search results matches the view count on the video page
testScenarios.expectedBehavior: View count in search results should match the view count displayed on the video page

testScenarios.name: Verify Video Title Consistency
testScenarios.description: Verify that the video title in search results matches the title on the video page
testScenarios.expectedBehavior: Video title in search results should exactly match the title on the video page

testScenarios.name: Verify Channel Name Consistency
testScenarios.description: Verify that the channel name shown in search results matches the channel name on the video page
testScenarios.expectedBehavior: Channel name in search results should match the channel name on both video and channel pages

testScenarios.name: Verify Video Duration Display
testScenarios.description: Verify that video duration shown in search results matches the duration displayed on the video page
testScenarios.expectedBehavior: Video duration in search results should match the duration shown on the video page
